# mergeah_tool_pack_standard_entity_rules (Data Source)

Read Merge Agent Handler tool_pack_standard_entity_rules. Results are available as JSON via response_json; paginated collections are fetched completely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
data "mergeah_tool_pack_standard_entity_rules" "example" {
  tool_pack_id = "a6d21b9d-6235-4f85-b175-0799fc4bfed1"
}

locals {
  tool_pack_standard_entity_rules = jsondecode(data.mergeah_tool_pack_standard_entity_rules.example.response_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tool_pack_id` (String) Merge API field `tool_pack_id`.

### Optional

- `query` (Map of String) Additional documented API query parameters. All pages are fetched automatically. Values must be strings.

### Read-Only

- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object for a detail endpoint, or JSON array containing every item for a collection. Use jsondecode to read fields. Sensitive because API records may contain personal data.
